summary.en: Nichiuri TV celebrates the opening of their new office building in Osaka and announce the production of the movie "Kaiju Gomera vs. Kamen Yaiba" by Taiho Pictures. Conan, Kogoro, Ran, the Detective Boys, Heiji and Kazuha are all there to take part in the filming as extras. TV producer Yonekura gets killed when a large monster action figure falls on him in the warehouse. Conan and Heiji deduce there were two culprits and that they are his subordinates Mihara and Kouchi, who killed Yonekura for taking credit for their work. Mihara and Kouchi try to escape arrest in Yonekura's car but Mihara is stopped by police. Kouchi drives off and crashes the car into a river. A bomb in the car goes off and kills him. Location: Nichiuri TV station, Osaka Victim: Isato Yonekura Cause of death: Stab wound Culprits: Takeru Kouchi and Yoshihito Mihara They ambushed him in the props room and dropped a large monster action figure on him. The fangs of the figure impale him to death. Location: Road near Osaka's Nichiuri TV station, Osaka Victims: Ran Mouri and Kazuha Toyama Age: 16 years old (Ran) and 17 years old (Kazuha) Attack types: Vehicular assault Culprit: Takeru Kouchi Trying to escape police, Kouchi drove Yonekura's black Lincoln Navigator that he had just stolen without his partner-in-crime Mihara since he was caught by the police. Since he didn't to stop his car, he nearly ran over Ran but she was saved on time by Fumimaro Ayanokoji who just happened to come by. Kazuha, who was walking with Ran, escaped getting ran over since Ran pushed her on the side. Bombing-Accidental Murder Location: Road near Osaka's Nichiuri TV station, Osaka Victim: Takeru Kouchi Cause of death: Explosion from car crash impact After driving past Ran, Kouchi sped but a taxi came from another runway and Kouchi was forced to turn at his right and crashed into the nearby river. The unstable explosive inside the car caused it to explode and kill Kouchi on the spot. It is believed by the police that the original target to be killed by the explosive was Yonekura and not Kouchi. The next day, Fumimaro Ayanokoji joins the investigation as Yonekura was connected to a scriptwriter Onda, who died in Kyoto the day before Yonekura's death when he drove off a cliff. Onda drives a red car on even days and a blue car on odd days but he died in the red car on an even day. Yonekura and Onda worked together on an independent film 20 years ago. A third death occurs in Suemura, an employee of Taiho Pictures, when a bomb explodes at an abandoned warehouse. Suemura was also a part of Yonekura's team 20 years ago. The bomb used matches the one that was in Yonekura's car and the police suspect a bomb was also used in Onda's death. They learn of a fourth member of the team 20 years ago in Katsuji Ishizawa and look for him only to find him bound and gagged in the kitchen of his own home. Bombing-Murder (Past) Location: Takaragaike road, Kyoto Victim: Takashi Onda Time: 2 days ago at night Cause of death: Explosion from car crash impact While Onda was drunk, he drove on Takaragaike and his car exploded killing him instantly. The explosive used was acetone peroxide, just like in Kouchi's car crash accident. Location: Unnamed company warehouse near Osaka Castle Victim: Ryohei Suemura Cause of death: Explosion Otaki comes to the filming site and brings Heiji and Conan to another case which just happened : Ryohei Suemura, an employee for the company which produces Kamen Yaiba vs. Gomera was killed when he opened a box of explosives (the same used in the previous murders) in an abandoned warehouse which was to be used to film some movie scenes. Ishizawa's brought to a hospital. He had been starved for two to three days with bruises all over. Conan and Kogoro investigate Ishizawa's residence. They deduce Ishizawa was locked in his room on the second floor, broke out and fell down the stairs but couldn't explain why he didn't go outside for help. Conan notices a newspaper in the entranceway with a story on Yonekura's death. Conan meets with Haibara, who tells Conan about how Yonekura, Onda and Suemura all paid off their debts ten years ago and, at around the same time, there was an unsolved robbery of 120 million yen by a four-man group. Also, before his death, Onda was close to bankruptcy after failed investments. Conan deduces the robbery was committed by Yonekura's team and the deaths were due to a falling out but can't work out the culprit. Conan considers the possibility that Yonekura killed Onda after being blackmailed but he couldn't explain why Yonekura's car had a bomb. Haibara suspects Ishizawa staged his confinement but Conan didn't find evidence of that. Conan couldn't explain why a bomb was only planted in one of Onda's two cars or why the bomb in Yonekura's car had no timer or detonator. Location: House in Sakai Victim: Katsuji Ishizawa While staking out his house, the police find out he has been bound and gagged inside it and that he was just barely alive. Fortunately, he survived and has been brought to the police hospital to recover. Location: Mansion in Kobe Victim: Old couple and two employees Robbed items: 120 million yen (approx. 1 million $ / 33.4 million ฿) Suspects: Isato Yonekura, Katsuji Ishizawa, Ryohei Suemura, Takashi Onda and an unknown person Ten years ago, four people robbed a mansion in Kobe and took away 120 million yen. Later investigations made it clear that the culprits were likely to be the four members of "Team Yonekura". While analyzing the proof that was on DVD, they find out that indeed the four of them were part of it but that there was a fifth member, the one who filmed the video. Location: Nichiuri TV Station, Osaka The culprit tried to kill Koichi Ishizawa by putting bombs at the place he worked. It turns out he didn't go and thus, Heiji and Conan have to disarm the bombs before the guests are hurt.
